items.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $6.3B in Q3 as BTC price rises nearly 43%
items.summary: Bitcoin gained 42.71% in Q3, its best third-quarter performance since 2017, as US spot ETFs attracted $6.34 billion in net inflows.
